meaning:
1) to lack, be without, decrease, be lacking, have a need
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to lack
1a2) to be lacking
1a3) to diminish, decrease
1b) (Piel) to cause to lack
1c) (Hiphil) to cause to be lacking

renderings.bsb: You made him a little lower

renderings.kjv: so that he shall have no need

elsewhere.note: The waters continually receded from the earth. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters receded.
When they measured it with an omer, he who gathered much had nothing over, and he who gathered little had no lack. They each gathered according to his eating.
For Yahweh your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has known your walking through this great wilderness. These forty years, Yahweh your God…
For Yahweh, the God of Israel says, ‘The jar of meal will not run out, and the jar of oil will not fail, until the day that Yahweh sends rain on the earth.’ ”
“Yes, forty years you sustained them in the wilderness. They lacked nothing. Their clothes didn’t grow old, and their feet didn’t swell.
For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.
The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.
